ProblemSection.title: Your company grew. The way it works didn’t.
ProblemSection.description: Processes live in people’s heads, information gets lost between emails, messages and side spreadsheets, and every team does things its own way. When a project comes up to fix it, the decision usually sits with whoever is selling, not whoever is buying.

ScenarioComparison.without_title: You manage the conflict, not the business.
ScenarioComparison.without_point_1: Systems bought to fix a process no one designed, so they don’t fix it.
ScenarioComparison.without_point_2: Proposals you can’t compare, and time and cost change orders halfway through.
ScenarioComparison.without_point_3: In the end you pay more, get less, and the original problem is still there.
ScenarioComparison.with_title: Technical authority on the side of whoever pays.
ScenarioComparison.with_point_1: You stay in control: proposals, schedule, costs and risks are visible at all times.
ScenarioComparison.with_point_2: We hold vendors to deadline, quality and scope, with you informed and part of every decision.
ScenarioComparison.with_point_3: We take no commission from vendors. Our recommendation is based only on what is best for your business.
ScenarioComparison.without_svg_label: Without Boomerang: you are tied to three suppliers, and the problem gets pushed from one to the other.
ScenarioComparison.with_svg_label: With Boomerang: we coordinate and hold the three vendors accountable together with you, and the delivery comes back accepted.
ScenarioComparison.suppliers_caption: held to deadline, quality and scope

MomentsSection.title: Where is your company right now?
MomentsSection.description: We work with companies in any industry. What matters is where the business is. Pick the situation closest to yours.

organize.situation: The work depends on a few people
organize.headline: We get processes out of people’s heads.
organize.body: Every team does things its own way and information gets lost. We understand how the work happens and organize the processes before thinking about any tool.

expansion.situation: I need a new system and don’t know where to start
expansion.headline: We design the solution before you talk to any vendor.
expansion.body: A new system, an integration or an IT restructuring. We weigh buying, customizing or building, and you compare proposals fairly, with scope, cost and schedule defined.

stalled.situation: The project stalled and change orders keep coming
stalled.headline: We find where it got stuck and take back control.
stalled.body: Deadlines blew up or change orders keep arriving. A quick diagnosis shows what was delivered, what is missing and who is responsible for what. Then we stay by your side managing the project.
stalled.service: Quick diagnosis, then Implementation and Delivery

integration.situation: The system arrived and doesn’t talk to the rest
integration.headline: We make what arrived work with what you already have.
integration.body: The system or equipment arrived, but it doesn’t talk to what you already have or doesn’t fit your operations. We adjust the processes and coordinate the vendors involved.

ongoing.situation: The company grew and needs ongoing oversight
ongoing.headline: A processes and technology team, without hiring one.
ongoing.body: The company grew and needs someone overseeing processes and technology on an ongoing basis, with reports in business language.

JourneySection.title: A journey in five stages.
JourneySection.description: Every project starts with a diagnosis and ends with the delivery. You can hire us for the full journey or join at the stage your company is in.

diagnosis.name: Diagnosis
diagnosis.do: We learn the business, current processes, systems, contracts and the real pain.
diagnosis.get: A clear picture of the situation, the risks and the priorities.
diagnosis.role: Open up the operation and validate the priorities.

design.name: Design and hiring
design.do: We design the solution, weigh buying, customizing or building, and support the hiring.
design.get: Vendors compared fairly, with scope, cost and schedule defined.
design.role: Choose the solution and the vendors, with the options and risks in plain view.

processes.name: Processes
processes.do: We redesign how work will happen with the new solution: flows, roles, rules and metrics. We simplify before we automate.
processes.get: Processes documented and validated with your team.
processes.role: Approve the new way of working.

implementation.name: Implementation
implementation.do: We coordinate vendors and partners through build, configuration and testing, and prepare your team.
implementation.get: A solution deployed and tested, with your team ready.
implementation.role: Decide at every milestone and take part in the tests.

delivery.name: Delivery
delivery.do: We lead the sign-off and acceptance, and follow through the warranty period.
delivery.get: A delivery signed off and followed through the warranty.

governance.name: Governance
governance.span: From hiring to the end of the warranty
governance.do: We track deadlines, cost, quality, risks and decisions at every stage, with reports in business language.
governance.get: A clear view of the project from start to finish.
governance.role: Set the goals and decide at the milestones.

JourneySection.note: Not every problem ends in a project. Sometimes the diagnosis shows that adjusting the process is enough, and that is a result too.

DnaSection.title_label: We speak the language of the engineer, the developer, the vendor and the business owner.
DnaSection.management_body: Critical systems integration, multi-vendor programs and deliveries in regulated environments, in Brazil and abroad.
DnaSection.processes_body: Generalists by choice: we look at the whole problem, from process to technology.
DnaSection.technology_body: When the solution calls for expertise we don’t have in-house, we bring in people who do: software development, information security, infrastructure and networks, electrical engineering and automation, data and artificial intelligence.
DnaSection.technology_item_1: Specialists presented with the reason for the choice and open pricing
DnaSection.technology_item_2: You approve who joins the project
DnaSection.technology_item_3: Boomerang stays responsible for the result
